_about: Owner-supplied and outside-git files for a new machine (paths only, never values). base: repo = legion/, ro = the folder that holds it (G:\RO), home = the user's profile. severity: blocking fails tools/system/portcheck.py; warn and optional are reported only. Read with tools/system/portcheck.py; the steps are in docs/SETUP-NEW-MACHINE.md.

items.note: template for .env (key names)
the stack; ro_dbdata volume is named by its project name ro
first DB init: 2 test accounts (loaded by rathena/start.sh)
bot accounts and characters: loaded by hand (SETUP guide, step DB)
4,000 personas, 7,817 characters; tracked; contains password fields (bug filed)
tracked engine settings (flags start OFF)
rAthena built from a pinned commit fetched from GitHub at build time
engine image; copies map data from the ro-rathena image
OpenKore built from a pinned commit fetched from GitHub at build time
project instruction file in G:\RO, outside git: the agent sessions read it
a DB dump of an older live state: restores characters, not the current world (see the guide)
Ayla's core party roster (runtime state, not in git)
created on first start when missing (legion/aylaoverride.go)
dashboard read login (key names only: db_user, db_pass); without it the dashboard uses the game user
item names for the dashboard; written by OpenKore (writer not found in repo)
per-character memory; empty is accepted (characters start without memory)
owner's kRO client (2021-01-07 RE): only for a human to watch or play; the engine needs no client
patched watch copy used by tools/rogui/ai-client.sh (Wine); optional
client data list for the watch copy; optional
the owner's own download of the full client; never fetched by the repo (G07)
item table read by tools/dashboard/buildexport.py only when rebuilding builds.json
